details:
- rebase onto Oracle 1.10.4-2.0.5.el7
- CVE-2026-18297: picked up from the vendor as Patch1006, which stops
  gst_opus_dec_negotiate() using channel positions above 64 channels
- the TuxCare duplicate opusdec-over-64-channels patch is dropped; the
  vendor's 1006-CVE-2026-18297.patch carries the same fix
- retain the two halves of our vorbis setup-packet backport the vendor still
  omits: gst_parse_vorbis_setup_packet() stays declared void in the vendor's
  Patch1003, so its five `return -1` statements are discarded and
  is_header_vorbis() still accepts a malformed packet, and its guards cover
  underrunning the ogg packet but not running both advance loops past
  op->packet + op->bytes
- retain the video-info overflow-check fix, since the vendor's Patch1004 guard
  computes the very product it is meant to reject and wraps for width/height
  near G_MAXINT with bpp > 2
